description:
Property tax appeal filing deadlines and the free / official filing route. `place`: 'cook' (Cook County,
        Illinois: the Assessor's live township calendar with each township's last file date and Board of Review window),
        'nyc' (Tax Commission: March 1 for tax classes 2-4, March 15 for class 1) or 'philadelphia' (Board of Revision of
        Taxes: first Monday of October). Optional `township` narrows Cook to one township (e.g. 'Berwyn', 'Lake View').
name: tax_appeal_deadlines
